verdict.rationale: Hummingbird is a SaaS compliance and case-management platform, so asking whether users can opt out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair question. Nothing in the evidence pack covers telemetry, analytics tracking or any opt-out control. The documented audit trail and data export features are different capabilities and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
